newsitem.title: USA: Boeing's new 747s to cost up to $7 bln - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Boeing's new 747s to cost up to $7 bln - WSJ.

text.p: Boeing Co's two new models of the 747 jumbo jets might cost up to $7 billion to develop, 40 percent more than the last estimate, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
The newspaper quoted the president of the company's commercial airplane group as saying final development costs of the two planes would total between $5 billion and $7 billion.
It said the president, Ronald Woodward, foresaw a final estimate of the project's total cost to materialize in the next few months.
He nevertheless said that the company would not go ahead with the project if it did not benefit its shareholders, it added.
Woodward said Boeing would probably go ahead with formal production of the models "well into next year", the newspaper said.
Two months ago, the company said it would cost $5 billion or more to develop the two jumbo jets, it said.
